name: native-cjs-startup
goal: Native main and preload bundles parse as CommonJS before launch; exclude browser-only SDK runtime from server token minting

steps.title: Identify the regression, prior working behavior, root cause, and evidence.
steps.evidence: GameRenderService runtime SDK import introduced browser worker import.meta into CommonJS main bundle; native launch threw SyntaxError before creating a window.

steps.title: Explain why existing standardized tests missed the regression; name the coverage gap and reusable test or shared guard change.
steps.evidence: Bun result.success checked bundling only; the native test timed out and startup logs were not inspected. The normal build now parses both main and preload with Node before success.

steps.title: Strengthen the existing standardized test and shared coverage; run it failing before repair and record the command, assertion and result.
steps.evidence: node --check packages/desktop/dist/main.cjs and guarded build:main both failed at WORKER_URL import.meta. Logs: /tmp/harness-native-bundle-red.log and /tmp/harness-native-guard-red.log.

steps.title: Propose a root-cause repair and an automated guard for the identified failure.
steps.evidence: Use server-only HTTP token minting with header credentials; retain disabled live-video boundary. Parse every CommonJS native artifact in the existing build command.

steps.title: Implement the repair and wire the prevention test or guard into normal project verification.
steps.evidence: Removed server runtime SDK import, added bounded header-auth token HTTP request and native build Node syntax guard for main and preload.

steps.title: Repeat repair and the same unchanged regression test until it passes; record passing proof.
steps.evidence: The unchanged guarded build passes; five game-host tests pass. Native app opens, selects the committed test game, and loads key, door, garden and vault image assets.

steps.title: In an isolated fixture or temporary workspace, prove reintroducing the original failure makes the guard fail; restore and prove it passes.
steps.evidence: An isolated copy of the original bundle /tmp/harness-native-before.cjs fails the identical node --check command at import.meta after the repaired bundles pass. No user app profile was cleared.

steps.title: Repeat until the guard and relevant project checks pass; verify affected UI flows with fresh inspected screenshots and no unexpected browser errors; preserve diagnostics and keep pending while proof fails.
